question: Why does Bhairava praise the goddess for asking about a matter rare even for gods?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval of the question
He acknowledges having been asked by the great goddess
The subject is described as hard to obtain even for the gods
inference: Bhairava praises the question because it concerns knowledge rare even among the gods
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess. I have been asked about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
